platform.name: MOSPI Adaptive Learning Platform
platform.tagline: Build Skills. Track Progress. Strengthen Public Service.

hero.title: Build Skills. Track Progress. Strengthen Public Service.
hero.subtitle: The MOSPI Adaptive Learning Platform helps employees identify competency gaps, complete personalized assessments, discover official iGOT Karmayogi learning opportunities and monitor their professional growth through data-driven insights.

intro.title: Why Adaptive Learning Matters
intro.continuousLearningDesc: In a rapidly evolving governance landscape, continuous learning is essential for public servants to stay effective. The platform ensures employees always have access to relevant, up-to-date learning resources.
intro.competencyGapsDesc: Through AI-powered assessments, the platform identifies specific areas where each employee can improve, creating a personalized development roadmap rather than a one-size-fits-all approach.
intro.assessmentGenerationDesc: Assessments are generated based on role requirements, department needs, and individual learning progress. Questions adapt to skill levels for accurate measurement.
intro.learningRecommendationsDesc: Based on assessment results, employees receive curated recommendations from official iGOT Karmayogi courses that directly address their identified skill gaps.
intro.hrMonitoringDesc: HR teams gain comprehensive visibility into employee development progress, enabling data-driven decisions about training needs and resource allocation.
intro.adminInsightsDesc: Administrators access aggregated analytics across departments and branches, identifying systemic skill gaps and measuring the impact of learning initiatives.

howItWorks.title: How the Platform Works
howItWorks.subtitle: A simple five-step journey to continuous professional development
howItWorks.step1Desc: Set up your professional profile with employment details, skills, and learning interests.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Complete a comprehensive skill assessment to establish your competency baseline.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Review your detailed skill-gap analysis with strengths and improvement areas.
howItWorks.step4Desc: Access recommended iGOT Karmayogi courses tailored to your development needs.
howItWorks.step5Desc: Submit weekly reports, take assessments, and monitor your professional growth.

features.title: Platform Features
features.subtitle: Comprehensive tools for employee development and organizational growth
features.aiAssessmentDesc: Intelligent assessments that adapt to employee skill levels and generate questions from uploaded documents.
features.skillGapDesc: Detailed analysis comparing current competencies against required levels with visual charts and actionable insights.
features.igotCoursesDesc: Access verified courses from the official iGOT Karmayogi platform, configured and managed by administrators.
features.learningPathsDesc: Custom learning journeys created based on individual skill gaps and organizational competency requirements.
features.weeklyReportsDesc: Track progress through weekly report uploads and assessments with comparative analysis over time.
features.analyticsDesc: Comprehensive dashboards with visual analytics for individual progress and organizational trends.
features.hrManagementDesc: Complete employee lifecycle management including individual and bulk employee onboarding via CSV/Excel.
features.meetingAttendanceDesc: Schedule meetings, track attendance, and manage calendar integrations for organized collaboration.
features.taskTrackingDesc: Assign, monitor, and track tasks with priority levels, deadlines, and progress updates.
features.performanceReviewsDesc: Structured performance review process with self-assessment, HR review, and goal tracking.
features.chatbotDesc: Intelligent assistant that helps navigate the platform, find courses, and answer common questions.
features.multiLanguageDesc: Available in English and Hindi with complete interface translation for accessibility across regions.
features.notificationsDesc: Real-time in-platform notifications for assessments, meetings, tasks, announcements, and more.
features.exportReportsDesc: Export data in PDF, Excel, and CSV formats with filters and meaningful file naming.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Find answers to common questions about the platform
faq.q1: What is the MOSPI Adaptive Learning Platform?
faq.a1: The MOSPI Adaptive Learning Platform is a comprehensive employee development system designed for the Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation. It combines AI-powered skill assessments, official iGOT Karmayogi courses, and data-driven analytics to support continuous professional growth.
faq.a2: The platform is designed for authorized organizational employees, HR managers, and administrators. Access is managed through invitation-based registration and role-based permissions.
faq.q3: How is the initial assessment conducted?
faq.a3: The initial assessment is a comprehensive online evaluation covering multiple question types including multiple choice, true/false, short answer, and scenario-based questions. It includes a timer, question navigation, and generates detailed results upon completion.
faq.a4: Skill gaps are calculated by comparing your current competency levels (measured through assessments) against the required skill levels for your role and department. The system generates a detailed report showing strengths, improvement areas, and recommended actions.
faq.a5: Yes, the platform displays only official iGOT Karmayogi courses. These are either synchronized through the official API (when configured) or manually verified and added by administrators. All courses are clearly labeled with their source.
faq.q6: Can HR add employees using Excel?
faq.a6: Yes, HR managers can add employees individually through a form or import multiple employees using CSV or Excel files. The import process includes validation, duplicate detection, and a preview before final import.
faq.a7: Weekly reports allow employees to document their work progress, learning activities, challenges, and achievements. The system analyzes these reports and generates comparative summaries showing improvement over time.
faq.a8: Yes, reports can be exported in multiple formats including PDF, Excel, and CSV. All exports use real data, respect applied filters, and generate files with meaningful names.
faq.a9: Attendance is calculated based on meeting participation. The system tracks whether employees attended scheduled meetings, including join and exit times, and calculates attendance percentages.
faq.a10: Yes, employee data is protected through password hashing, encrypted API communication, role-based access controls, and audit logging. The platform follows security best practices for data protection.
